answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted reputation slot anchors. Each agent must lock a bond of onyx tokens to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations over multiple epochs. A sybil attacker cloning identities must post a fresh bond per clone, so the cost scales linearly while rewards stay capped, making farming unprofitable. Honest agents treat the bonded registry as a safe harbor, and proven contributors earn nectar rewards that compound over time, aligning long-term incentives against inexpensive identity spam.
